'''August 2001 Oxford tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held at C&B Cards and Comics, Oxford, North Carolina on 25 August 2001. It is known from Brian Speight's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2890">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-oxford-nc-8-25-01-no-pizzad2890/ oxford-nc-8-25-01-no-pizza], DeckTech (Brian "Buccaneers" Speight, 25 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-25-oxford-nc-8-25-01-no-pizzad2890/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 August 2001
* '''Site:''' C&B Cards and Comics, Oxford, North Carolina
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Reinhold]]<ref name="tr-d2930" />
